name: Swarm of Crabs
desc:
A terrifying site to behold has hundreds of chitinous crabs scuttle
about, pincers clacking menacingly.
motives: Defend your territory, defend your brood, pinch, don't let go

features.name: Horde (1d4+2)
features.desc:
When the crabs have marked half or
more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4 + 2 physical
damage instead.

features.name: Strong Grip
features.desc:
When a target is hit by the crabs
pincers, spend a Fear to have 1d4+3 crabs latch on to the
target and not let go. Failed attacks on the latched on crabs
strike the whomever they’re latched on instead. Other actions
to remove the crabs may yield no damage to the target at the
GM's discretion.
